Business Analyst Co-op
Meridian Trust Bank

Meridian Trust Bank is seeking a Business Analyst Co-op student for a 8 month work term
beginning in January.

Location: Toronto, Ontario
Work model: Hybrid
Term: Winter 2027
Compensation: $25.00/hour

The successful candidate will support requirements gathering and process mapping for our
retail banking modernization program.

What You Will Do
- Facilitate stakeholder requirements sessions and document user stories
- Perform gap analysis across current and future state processes
- Partner with project delivery teams throughout the release cycle

How to Apply
Apply by December 5, 2026. Interviews will begin the week of December 15, 2026.
